title: Kagamine Len — Sending An Extra Special Heart〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome to our Valentine's Day show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's that special day when you show your appreciation for those around you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy our performance of gratitude until the very end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's get started, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy Valentine's Day, everyone in the front♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy Valentine's Day, everyone in the back!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy Valentine's Day♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was just the first song, but everyone's going nuts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're going all-in on the fan interaction, even while singing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they're really after everyone's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how things unfold from here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep raising the temperature!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here comes our next song!
Halfway through the show

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place for us to do our special Valentine's Day activity!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay♪ It's time for the heart pose contest♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll now take turn striking poses which involve hearts in some way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a competition to see who does the best pose.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We put quite a lot of thought into our poses, so we hope you enjoy them♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also stand to learn quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, let's draw straws to see who goes first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(I'm going last.
That means my pose will be the freshest in everyone's minds.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Unless one of the others does something similar. Then it'll end up being extra awkward for me...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But I came up with a pose that I think everyone is going to enjoy. So, I've just gotta do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I'm up first!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's make some fun and exciting memories together! This heart is just for you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you for making such a cute heart!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She made a heart in front of her chest using her hands... It's pretty standard, but she nailed it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Miku went with a standard, cute pose.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (She knows her strengths, and she pulled off her pose beautifully.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not about to let Miku walk away with this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I want you all to have the best Valentine's Day ever! So, don't take your eyes off of me today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (He made a heart with his fingers and winked. More of a cool pose that goes along with his personality.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It hits a different appeal from Miku's, and everyone seems to be enjoying it.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nicely done, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! You looked really cool, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, we also have some incredible poses in store for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Luka went with something more grown-up, while MEIKO focused on looking beautiful.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(And Rin was full of energy...
They're all expressing themselves really well through their poses.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Last but not least, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I need to use the momentum they've built up to strike a good pose.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for all your support!
You guys are the best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What an incredible response...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He made a heart on his cheek and winked...!
That was a great pose, Len!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was cute, but also kind of cool at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And he acted totally natural. It was almost unfair how cute he looked...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, we've all done our poses now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see who struck the best one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
I'm fairly certain that we all know who won.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The winner of our heart pose contest is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
I'm glad you all enjoyed our Valentine's Day activity!
After the show

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was such an amazing show, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The performance was incredible too, but the way you interacted with your fans was outstanding.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. That was a great way to show your fans just how much you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm glad you all enjoyed the show♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And your posing contest was also very fun. Congratulations on your win, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Your pose was so good, Len!
Actually, all of you did an amazing job. We really learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so kind of you.
I'd love to hear more of your thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! Let's see... Well, I think...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, Len.
Your pose turned out even better than when we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Shizuku.
I never would've been able to do that without your help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So, thank you.
I'm really glad that I asked you for your advice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm also glad that I was able to help you like this.
